since.title: SUPER
since.text: SUPER: a shape for its seven voices, the oscillator's WAVE on its + page (WAVE SIDE, then NOISE NCOL or SYNC RING): SAW as before; SQR, DETUN also spreading the side squares' widths (50 +- 30 %), hollow like a PWM; TRI, a narrower spread and a fold on the sum that grows with DETUN; SIN, seven detuned sines, the slow beating of an organ or a pad. STD is unchanged. New presets F15 SQUARES (SUPER SQR) and F16 GLASS (SUPER TRI).

notes.title: Oscillators
notes.text: Oscillators: two per voice, each with its own engine (ALGORITHM): STD (SAW SQR TRI SIN RAMP FOLD FM OCT, shaped by PW), SUPER (seven detuned saws), WT (four wavetable banks, alias-free) or GRAIN (granular over three samples).

notes.title: Voice
notes.text: Voice: OSC 2 with SEMI, FINE and MIX; SUB and NOISE in six colours; SYNC and RING; a 12 or 24 dB filter (LP BP HP NOTCH) with DRIVE; amp and filter ADSRs with velocity, key tracking and LOOP; GLIDE.

notes.title: Modes
notes.text: Modes: POLY (4 voices), MONO, LEGATO and UNI (the four voices on one note, detuned and spread in stereo).

notes.title: Modulation
notes.text: Modulation: two LFOs (SIN TRI SAW SQR S&H, 0.05 to 40 Hz) with TRIG, FADE and PHASE, each to one destination, per oscillator too.

notes.title: Effects
notes.text: Effects: delay, room reverb (Hortator's) and a stereo chorus; stereo out with a soft clip.

notes.title: Presets
notes.text: Presets: 14 factory sounds and 16 of your own on the flash (A/B records: a power cut keeps the previous bank).

notes.title: Screen
notes.text: Screen: each page draws what it edits (the envelope curves, the LFO wave, the filter response, the wavetable, the live grains), in the ObsSynth palettes.

notes.title: GLOBAL
notes.text: GLOBAL: MIDI channel, master tuning, velocity curve, button lights and the screen palette, kept apart from the presets.

notes.title: USB
notes.text: USB: class-compliant USB-MIDI in, the M-UPGRADE update entry and Felucca's update loader, so the FM-1 can always leave this firmware again.

notes.title: Flash
notes.text: Flash: both FM-1 flash chips (Puya P25Q80 and the UC25HQ80 of units sold since autumn 2026).

notes.title: Package
notes.text: Package: identity FM-1_917; built and signed by GitHub from the tagged source (fm1-build).
